title: Design org/member/role Prisma schema
body: Define the initial Prisma schema for Organization, Member, Role, and Invite entities. Should support org-scoped roles (admin, treasurer, member, auditor) and branch/committee sub-grouping planned for v1.0 (leave a nullable branchId for forward compatibility).

title: Implement organization creation API endpoint
body: POST /orgs — creates an organization, assigns the creator as admin. Validate name/slug uniqueness. Add request validation with class-validator DTOs.

title: Implement member invite flow (email-based)
body: POST /orgs/:id/invites — generates a signed invite token, sends an email via the notification worker. Invite acceptance creates a Member record with a default role.

title: Add role-based access control (RBAC) guard for API routes
body: NestJS guard that checks the requesting member's org-scoped role against a route's required permission. Should be declarative via a decorator, e.g. @RequireRole('treasurer').

title: Org switcher UI component
body: Dashboard header component to switch between organizations a member belongs to. Persists last-selected org in a cookie.

title: Design branch & committee data model
body: Extend the org schema to support branches (e.g. regional chapters) and committees (e.g. loan committee) with their own scoped permissions.

title: Audit log for org-level admin actions
body: Record who changed what (role changes, member removal, settings changes) with timestamp and actor. Expose a read-only audit log view for admins.

title: CSV bulk-import for existing member rosters
body: Let a new org admin upload a CSV of existing members (name, phone, email) during onboarding instead of inviting one by one.

title: Extend treasury contract: multisig withdrawal with threshold approval
body: Add withdraw() requiring N-of-M signer approval. Store signer set and threshold in contract storage, gated by set_signers()/set_threshold() callable only by governance.

title: Treasury contract: spending policy limits
body: Support per-period spending caps (e.g. max withdrawal per day) enforced at the contract level, configurable by governance.

title: Wire treasury.deposit to Stellar Asset Contract token transfer
body: Currently the treasury scaffold only records a balance; wire it to actually move a configured SAC token (e.g. USDC) using the token client interface.

title: API: build & submit signed treasury transactions
body: Backend service that builds a Soroban transaction envelope for deposit/withdraw, returns it unsigned to the client for member signing, then submits once signed.

title: Reconciliation worker: on-chain events to off-chain ledger
body: BullMQ job that polls/subscribes to Soroban contract events and reconciles them against pending off-chain records, marking them confirmed/failed.

title: Treasury balance widget (dashboard)
body: Read-only widget showing current treasury balance, sourced from the API which itself reconciles against the contract.

title: Freighter wallet connect flow
body: Integrate Freighter (or compatible) wallet connection for member-signed actions (deposits, votes). Handle 'wallet not installed' gracefully with install prompt.

title: Contract: emit structured events for deposit/withdraw
body: Ensure treasury contract emits typed events with enough data for the reconciliation worker to avoid extra RPC calls.

title: Support multiple asset types per treasury (XLM + stablecoins)
body: Extend treasury balance tracking to be per-asset rather than a single implicit asset.

title: Treasury contract audit prep: threat model doc
body: Write a threat model for the treasury contract (privileged functions, trust assumptions, failure modes) ahead of the external audit gate in ROADMAP v0.5.

title: Savings cycle data model & API
body: Model recurring contribution cycles (weekly/monthly, fixed amount or flexible) scoped to a group within an org.

title: Record a manual contribution (cash entry, non-blockchain)
body: For groups not yet fully on-chain: let a treasurer record a contribution received off-platform, still reflected in reporting/analytics.

title: Contribution reminder scheduling
body: BullMQ recurring job that checks upcoming/missed contributions and enqueues notification jobs (email/SMS) ahead of the due date.

title: Savings cycle creation UI
body: Admin-facing form to configure a new contribution cycle: frequency, amount, start/end date, penalty rules.

title: Member contribution history view
body: Dashboard page showing a member's own contribution history for a given cycle, with on-time/late indicators.

title: Penalty calculation for late/missed contributions
body: Configurable penalty rules (flat fee or percentage) applied automatically when a contribution is marked late, with an admin override path.

title: Savings analytics: cycle completion rate
body: Compute and expose the percentage of members who completed a cycle on time, for the analytics dashboard.

title: Flexible/variable contribution amounts
body: Support cycles where members can contribute a variable amount above a minimum, rather than only fixed amounts.

title: SMS reminder provider integration (Africa's Talking or similar)
body: Pluggable SMS provider interface plus a first concrete implementation, used by the reminder job.

title: CSV export of a cycle's contribution history
body: Let a treasurer export a completed cycle's contributions as CSV for offline record-keeping.

title: Loan request data model & API
body: Model loan requests: amount, purpose, requested term, requesting member, status (pending/approved/rejected/disbursed/repaid).

title: Guarantor flow: request & confirm guarantorship
body: A borrower nominates one or more guarantors; guarantors must explicitly confirm before the loan request can move to committee review.

title: Loan approval workflow (committee voting)
body: Support single-approver and committee-quorum approval modes, configurable per org.

title: Repayment schedule generator
body: Given principal, interest rate, and term, generate an amortization schedule (equal installments to start; reducing-balance as a stretch goal).

title: Interest calculation module
body: Implement flat-rate and reducing-balance interest calculation as pure, well-tested functions in packages/utilities.

title: Overdue loan tracking & flagging
body: Scheduled job to flag installments past due, update loan status, and notify borrower + guarantors.

title: Loan request UI (borrower flow)
body: Multi-step form: amount/purpose, guarantor selection, review & submit.

title: Loan committee review UI
body: Queue view for committee members to review pending loan requests and vote/approve.

title: Guarantor liability display
body: Show a member their total outstanding guarantor exposure across all loans they've backed, so they understand their risk before confirming a new one.

title: Loan repayment recording (manual + on-chain)
body: Support recording a repayment both as a manual entry and as a reconciled on-chain treasury deposit tagged to a specific loan.

title: Design dividends contract: pull-based claim model
body: Contract design doc: how profit pools are funded, how a member's share is computed, and how claims are made (pull vs. push), favoring pull for gas/complexity reasons.

title: Implement dividends contract: fund pool & claim
body: fund_pool() to add to a distribution pool, claim() for a member to withdraw their computed share. Must be re-entrancy safe and idempotent per distribution round.

title: Dividend share calculation: proportional to contributions
body: Compute a member's dividend share proportional to their recorded contributions over a period, as the default (configurable) distribution formula.

title: Dividends contract unit tests: edge cases
body: Test zero-balance members, rounding remainders, double-claim prevention, and claims after a member has left the org.

title: Dividend distribution history UI
body: Member-facing view of past dividend distributions and their claim status.

title: Admin flow: initiate a dividend distribution round
body: Treasurer/admin UI to configure and trigger a new distribution round, with a confirmation step showing computed per-member shares before execution.

title: Dividend rounding remainder handling
body: Decide and implement a policy for leftover remainder from integer division (e.g. carry to next round vs. send to treasury reserve).

title: Dividends contract audit prep
body: Threat model + test coverage report ahead of the v0.5 external audit gate.

title: Design governance contract: proposal lifecycle
body: Design doc for proposal states (draft/active/passed/rejected/executed/expired), voting window, and quorum calculation.

title: Implement governance contract: create & vote on proposals
body: propose(), vote(), and tally logic with configurable quorum and voting period.

title: Governance contract: execute approved treasury actions
body: Cross-contract call from governance to treasury to execute an approved spending proposal once quorum + approval threshold are met.

title: Voting power model: one-member-one-vote vs. contribution-weighted
body: RFC + implementation for how voting power is computed; needs a Discussion before implementation given the tradeoffs.

title: Proposal creation & voting UI
body: Member-facing UI to browse active proposals, view details, and cast a vote (wallet-signed).

title: Governance contract: timelock for contract upgrades
body: Require a timelock delay between a governance-approved upgrade and its execution, so members have time to react.

title: Quorum edge case tests: low-participation proposals
body: Test behavior when turnout is below quorum at the voting deadline (should expire, not silently pass).

title: Governance contract audit prep
body: Threat model + test coverage ahead of the v1.0 audit gate.

title: Treasury dashboard: inflows/outflows chart
body: Time-series chart of treasury inflows vs. outflows over a selectable period.

title: Treasury dashboard: reserves indicator
body: Show current reserve level against a configured target reserve, with a visual warning state when below target.

title: Expense recording & categorization
body: Let a treasurer record non-loan, non-dividend expenses with categories, for accurate treasury dashboard reporting.

title: Treasury dashboard: transaction drill-down
body: Click into a treasury dashboard chart point to see the underlying transactions.

title: Investment tracking (external to on-chain treasury)
body: Track group investments held outside the Stellar treasury (e.g. land, equipment) for a complete net-worth picture in reporting.

title: Treasury dashboard: mobile-responsive layout pass
body: Audit and fix the treasury dashboard for small-screen usability.

title: Monthly report generation (PDF)
body: Scheduled job that generates a monthly org financial summary as PDF (contributions, loans, treasury balance) and stores it for download.

title: Excel export for contribution/loan data
body: Add .xlsx export alongside PDF for members who want to work with the data further.

title: Annual report template
body: Design and implement a yearly summary report layout, distinct from the monthly one.

title: Audit report: full transaction trail export
body: Export every recorded transaction (on-chain + manual) for a given period, formatted for external auditor review.

title: Report generation queue & retry handling
body: Ensure report generation jobs (which can be slow for large orgs) are queued, retried on failure, and don't block API request threads.

title: Report download UI & history
body: Dashboard page listing previously generated reports with download links.

title: Localized report templates (starting with currency formatting)
body: Support locale-aware number/currency formatting in generated reports as a first step toward full i18n in v2.0.

title: Notification provider abstraction (email/SMS/push)
body: Define a common interface so email, SMS, and push providers can be swapped without touching call sites.

title: Email notification provider (SMTP/transactional email service)
body: First concrete implementation of the notification provider interface.

title: In-app notification center
body: Bell icon + dropdown showing recent in-app notifications, with read/unread state.

title: Notification preferences per member
body: Let members opt in/out of specific notification types and channels.

title: Push notification provider (web push)
body: Implement web push as another notification provider, gated behind user opt-in.

title: Notification templates system
body: Centralize notification copy as templates with variable interpolation, so wording changes don't require code changes.

title: Digest notifications (daily/weekly summary)
body: Optional digest mode that batches non-urgent notifications instead of sending immediately.

title: Analytics event pipeline
body: Lightweight internal event tracking (contribution made, loan approved, vote cast) feeding into aggregate tables for the analytics dashboard.

title: Member activity analytics view
body: Show org admins member engagement over time (contributions, votes, logins).

title: Loan statistics dashboard
body: Default/on-time repayment rates, average loan size, and portfolio-at-risk metrics.

title: Treasury analytics: growth over time
body: Chart treasury balance growth over time with configurable date ranges.

title: Contribution analytics: cohort comparison
body: Compare contribution consistency across different savings groups within the same org.

title: Analytics data export API
body: Expose the underlying analytics aggregates via API for orgs that want to build custom dashboards.

title: Analytics dashboard performance: materialized views
body: Move slow aggregate queries to materialized views refreshed on a schedule, once real usage data shows query latency issues.

title: SDK: TypeScript client scaffold for the API
body: Generate/hand-write a typed client for core API endpoints (orgs, savings, loans) as the foundation of @lumio/sdk.

title: SDK: Soroban transaction-building helpers
body: Wrap common Soroban transaction construction (deposit, vote, claim dividend) behind simple SDK functions.

title: SDK: contract event subscription helper
body: Convenience wrapper for subscribing to/polling Soroban contract events, used by both the API reconciliation worker and third-party integrators.

title: SDK: publish to npm as @lumio/sdk
body: Set up the package.json, build config, and CI step to publish the SDK independently of the rest of the monorepo.

title: SDK: usage example — create org & record a contribution
body: A runnable example under examples/ showing the full flow end-to-end in under 30 lines.

title: SDK: React hooks package
body: Optional @lumio/sdk-react package with hooks (useTreasuryBalance, useProposals) for consumers building on React.

title: SDK: error handling & typed error classes
body: Replace generic thrown errors with typed error classes so SDK consumers can handle specific failure modes.

title: SDK: Rust client for third-party integrations
body: Rust equivalent of the TypeScript SDK, for integrators working outside the JS ecosystem.

title: Design system: token setup (color, spacing, typography)
body: Establish the base design tokens in packages/ui as Tailwind config + CSS variables.

title: Design system: Button, Input, Select primitives
body: Core form primitives built on shadcn/ui, themed with Lumio's design tokens.

title: Design system: data table component
body: Reusable sortable/filterable table used across contribution, loan, and report lists.

title: Design system: empty states & loading skeletons
body: Consistent empty-state and skeleton-loading components for use across the dashboard.

title: Design system: Storybook setup
body: Add Storybook to packages/ui so components can be developed and reviewed in isolation.

title: Accessibility audit of core components
body: Run an a11y audit (axe or similar) over packages/ui primitives and fix issues found.

title: Write ADR template & first ADR (on-chain treasury as source of truth)
body: Add docs/adr/ with a lightweight ADR template, and write ADR-0001 referenced from docs/architecture.md.

title: API reference documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)
body: Generate and publish OpenAPI docs from the NestJS API, served at /docs.

title: Contract API reference (per-contract function docs)
body: Document each public contract function's parameters, auth requirements, and possible panics, generated from doc comments where possible.

title: Deployment guide: self-hosting with Docker Compose
body: Step-by-step guide for a co-op to self-host the full stack, including Stellar network configuration choices.

title: FAQ page
body: Collect and answer common questions from Discussions/support into a living FAQ doc.

title: Troubleshooting guide
body: Document common local-dev issues (from the Getting Started troubleshooting section) in more depth as they're reported.

title: Translate README into French
body: First localized README, targeting Francophone West African cooperative communities.

title: Video walkthrough: local dev setup
body: Short screen-recording walkthrough of the Getting Started guide, linked from the docs site.

title: Set up Playwright for e2e testing
body: Configure Playwright against the dashboard app with a basic smoke-test suite (login, view treasury balance).

title: Preview deployments for PRs
body: Configure preview deploys (Vercel or similar) for apps/dashboard on every PR.

title: Terraform module: base infrastructure
body: Terraform for the managed Postgres, Redis, and app hosting environment used in staging/production.

title: Add Scout static analysis to contracts CI
body: Integrate CoinFabrik's Scout (or similar Soroban-focused static analyzer) into the contracts CI job.

title: Docker production images
body: Multi-stage Dockerfiles for apps/api and apps/dashboard optimized for production (not just the dev compose setup).

title: Add bundle-size CI check for frontend apps
body: Fail CI (or warn) if a PR significantly increases the dashboard's JS bundle size.

title: Rate limiting on auth endpoints
body: Add rate limiting (e.g. via Redis) to login/OTP endpoints to mitigate brute-force attempts.

title: Input validation audit across API DTOs
body: Review all NestJS DTOs for missing or weak validation (class-validator decorators), particularly on amount/financial fields.

title: Secrets handling review
body: Audit how secrets (JWT signing key, provider API keys) are loaded and ensure none can leak into logs or client bundles.

title: Add security headers middleware
body: Configure standard security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.) for apps/api responses.

title: Dependency vulnerability scanning gate in CI
body: Fail CI on newly introduced high/critical vulnerabilities from `pnpm audit` / `cargo audit`.

title: Document key management options for treasurers
body: Compare self-custody vs. custodial-fallback signing UX for non-technical treasurers, feeding the open question in docs/architecture.md.
